card.architecture: sketchKeras (higumax pytorch port, fixed 512 U-Net) line extractor + thicken + multiply composite — no diffusion checkpoint
card.summary: Extracts the source's lines with sketchKeras (dark-on-white), boldens them, and multiplies over the source so only the lines darken. Weights converted from lllyasviel/sketchKeras mod.h5 and present under vendor/sketchKeras-pytorch/weights/model.pth.
use_cases: thicken outlines using the sketchKeras line extractor
card.pick_when: You specifically want sketchKeras line extraction.
